questions: For decode_cyclic, is the intended behavior to apply encode_cyclic twice (as in the reference solution) or to reverse the encoding by shifting groups of three characters in the opposite direction (i.e., group[-1] + group[:-1])?

Does encode_cyclic shift groups of three characters by moving the first character to the end (left rotation) or the last character to the front (right rotation)? The code shows left rotation, but the docstring says 'shifting' which is ambiguous.
If the input string to encode_cyclic is empty, should the output be an empty string?
For groups of fewer than three characters, should they remain unchanged, or should they be padded to three characters before shifting?
Is the encoding/decoding intended to work on strings containing non-ASCII characters (e.g., Unicode) or only ASCII?
Should decode_cyclic raise an error if the input string length is not a multiple of three, or handle it the same as encode_cyclic?
Is the grouping for encoding always done from left to right, starting at index 0, or could it be right-to-left or with overlap?
For decode_cyclic, if the input was not produced by encode_cyclic (e.g., malformed), should it attempt to decode anyway or validate first?
